First release of ps1-test: a PlayStation emulator page and an AI test harness.

- **Play page** (`index.html`): EmulatorJS 4.2.3 with the PCSX-ReARMed core and the
  free OpenBIOS; `.cue`/`.bin`/`.iso`/`.exe`/`.zip`, your own BIOS dump or HLE, a
  bundled demo. Ready for Vercel (`vercel.json`).
- **MCP server** (31 tools): deterministic frame-exact play, digital/DualShock pads
  and analog sticks, screenshots, video, goldens, save states, RAM/scratchpad/I/O
  read and write, RAM search, GameShark codes, memory cards, A/B comparison,
  replayable scripts.
- **PS1 inspection** from an instrumented core: every GPU command per frame
  (`gpu_capture`), VRAM viewer with texture pages and CLUTs, CPU exceptions,
  `check` with hardware rules (EXE/SYSTEM.CNF, hangs, lag, CPU load, GPU limits,
  DMA, stack).
- **Development**: PSn00bSDK template (`new_project`) with a passing test, CI and a
  dev container; `build` with file:line errors; converters for PNG → TIM, Tiled
  maps, WAV → VAG, OBJ meshes and lookup tables.
- **Claude Code plugin**: the server plus skills (testing, playtesting, CI,
  homebrew, PSn00bSDK, hardware, performance, real hardware) and the `ps1-tester`
  and `ps1-reviewer` agents.
